svg.title: Sign-in, step by step
svg.desc: The app posts email and password to our API. The API checks Firebase, stores the account in Postgres, and returns our own session token.
svg.text: Firebase proves the password. We keep the account. The phone keeps our token.

g.text: The app posts email and password to POST /api/auth/login (or /signup).
AuthController asks FirebaseAuthClient. Ten tries per minute, per address.
Firebase returns a uid and an email. We do not forward Firebase's token.
AccountService.link finds or creates the row in app_user. Username comes from the email.
SessionService signs an HS256 token: subject = user id, issuer = aniga, life = 30 days.
The app saves that token. Later calls send Authorization: Bearer. The user id in the URL must match it.

svg.text: The signing key is SHA-256 of ANIGA_SESSION_SECRET. The secret is generated on the server and is not in the APK.
